draft.title: Rivers shaping the land
card: A river changes the land in two main ways. It erodes, which means it wears rock and soil away. It also deposits, which means it drops the sediment it carries.
near the source, usually in hills or mountains. The water flows fast down steep slopes and cuts down into the land, making V-shaped valleys and gorges.
near the mouth, where the land is flat and the river slows. It drops sediment and builds floodplains, the flat land beside the river that is covered in a flood.
where a slow river meets the sea or a lake and drops its sediment, which builds new land. The sediment can spread out in a fan shape.
draft.remember: Rivers cut down where they are steep and fast, and build up where they are flat and slow.

a.q: A river runs fast down a steep mountain slope and cuts a deep, narrow V-shaped valley. Which process is mainly at work?
opts: Delta building at the river mouth
a.why: Fast water on a steep slope has the energy to wear rock away, and that is erosion. Deposition is tempting, but it happens where the river slows and drops what it carries.
a.clue: Is the river taking material away or dropping it?

b.q: Mei visits a wide, flat plain beside a slow river near its mouth. Fine mud covers the plain after each flood. Why is the mud there?
opts: The slow river drops sediment when it floods
The fast river cuts the mud from a gorge there
The river cuts a V-shaped valley into the plain
The sea waves carry mud up the river each flood
b.why: On flat land the river is slow, so it drops its sediment and builds a floodplain. Cutting is wrong here, because that happens in the steep upper course where water is fast.
b.clue: Think about how fast the river moves on flat land.

wants.brief: A labelled river from source to mouth. Upper course: steep, V-shaped valley and gorge. Lower course: flat floodplain beside the river. Delta: a fan of sediment where the river meets the sea.
wants.why: It lets students see where each landform sits along a river.

b.best: The slow river drops sediment when it floods
